hardware.housing: wall-mount with short cable-run to machine
hardware.notes: SFF machine in adjacent space, screen protector used

features.name: Calendar API Integration
features.notes: Google, Apple iCloud CalDAV, Outlook OAuth all wired. Phase 3A–3D features shipped (chores, routines, rewards, meals, recipes, screensaver, sleep, virtual keyboard).

features.name: Display Driver / Rendering
features.notes: Kiosk mode (NEXT_PUBLIC_LOCAL_MODE), cursor hide, sleep/wake via rtcwake, screensaver slideshow.

features.name: UI Layout
features.notes: Balanced Hearth Phase 2 shipped (commit ece7daa). SVG stroke tab icons + per-condition weather icons. getEventPillColors() utility routes CSS var fill/ink/bar tokens correctly — fixes broken oklch pill rendering across all 5 calendar views.

features.name: Authentication / OAuth
features.notes: Multi-user auth + role system (admin/member/guest). JWT sessions, bcrypt passwords, PIN lock for Settings.

features.name: Auto-refresh / Scheduling
features.notes: Configurable refresh interval (default 5 min), localStorage event cache for snappy reloads.
